name: omnimodal
description: Multimodal plugin for Codex and Claude Code: recognize audio, images, and video through Doubao, GLM, or Qwen-compatible APIs, plus image, video, and speech generation.

interface.shortDescription: Recognize audio, images, and video and generate images, video, and speech with Doubao and Qwen-compatible APIs
interface.longDescription: Adds read_image, read_images_batch, read_video, capture_page, and native Windows capture_windows/list_windows MCP tools.
defaultPrompt: Read this local image and extract the requested content.
